jurisdiction_sources.note: 16 V.S.A. section 603(a)(1)(F) inventory: Missisquoi Valley Supervisory District -- the Missisquoi Valley School District (a unified union district created by the State Board's November 28, 2018 Act 46 order, operational July 1, 2019) is its own supervisory district (member towns: Franklin, Highgate, Swanton). Operates PK-12.

sources.note: Missisquoi Valley SD: nine directors, residency allocated Franklin 3 / Highgate 3 / Swanton 3, elected by the whole district electorate (modified at-large, 16 V.S.A. section 730(a)(2) pattern -- flagged: the adopted 2019 articles were not located verbatim; see the sources). No term expirations are published -- all memberships carry no end. Identity note: meeting coverage also names an "Elaine Nester" as district finance staff; the Directors page lists Elaine Nester of Highgate as a director -- minted as a new person on the page's evidence, with no reuse linkage asserted. Missisquoi Valley School District Directors page (official): nine directors, three per town by residency -- Highgate: Renick Darnell-Martin (Chair), Chris Shepard, Elaine Nester; Swanton: Stephanie Gagne (Vice Chair), Donald Collins, Chevon Cooper; Franklin: Pierrette Bouchard, Anthony Bessette, Peter Magnant. The page publishes NO term expirations.

MVSD Transition Board minutes, March 25, 2019 (official district document): the board adopted the Articles of Agreement presented by the Franklin Northwest Amendment Committee, including the "nine member board article." The adopted articles' verbatim text was not located (missing document), and no term expirations are published anywhere fetched (missing: the MVSD Annual Meeting Warning for March 3, 2026, or the 2025-2026 annual report roster). The modified at-large model (residency seats, district-wide vote) rests on the State Board default-articles framework carried from the predecessor MVU board -- flagged.
